working_definition: A 44-cell adult brain population recovered from the neuropeptide re-clustering by expression of FMRFamide (FMRFa), a classical Drosophila neuropeptide gene expressed by a large, heterogeneous set of ~90 morphologically distinct neurons spanning brain, subesophageal zone and ventral nerve cord (White et al., 1999). FMRFa marks a neurochemical class distributed across many otherwise-unrelated neuron types, not a single anatomical cell type; the parent res-2.0 cluster (16) is large, heterogeneous and 'Unannotated', with no FMRFa-specific top markers and no independent (res-8.0) cross-check.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any peptidergic neuron of the adult.

justification: FBbt has no generic 'FMRFamide neuron' gene-expression class (unlike its CCAP/CCHamide-1/corazonin/Ms/GPA2-GPB5 neuron classes) -- only two specific, disambiguated FMRFamide-expressing interneuron subtypes (FMRFamide SE2 neuron, FBbt:00001981; FMRFamide SE3 neuron, FBbt:00100392), each a single named subesophageal-zone cell type. This transcriptomic cluster explicitly cannot be resolved to either of those (or to any other single FMRFa+ type): the report's own analysis concludes FMRFa marks a co-expression class spanning ~90 distinct neurons of many types, and the honest target is a broad, non-specific parent. 'Adult peptidergic neuron' is the best defensible common parent covering this heterogeneous population; a more specific FBbt term would misrepresent the data even if one existed.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Bilaterally paired FMRFamide expressing interneuron of the subesophageal neuromere, located more anteriorly than the FMRFamide SE3 cells (Schneider et al., 1993).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: A single specific named cell type (paired interneurons of the SEZ); this 44-cell cluster is not resolved to any single FMRFa+ subtype and likely pools many anatomically distinct FMRFa neurons, not just the SE2 pair.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: FMRFamide expressing interneuron of the subesophageal neuromere located more posteriorly than the FMRFamide SE2 neurons (Schneider et al., 1993).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Same reasoning as FMRFamide SE2 neuron: too specific a single subtype for this heterogeneous, unresolved 44-cell cluster.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058202 'adult peptidergic neuron' as an honest broad match with low confidence, reflecting that FMRFa marks a co-expression class spanning many distinct, anatomically unrelated adult neuron types that this cluster does not resolve. No FBbt term exists at an intermediate 'FMRFamide-expressing neuron' class level (unlike other neuropeptides in this dataset), but since even such a term would only be a similarly broad grouping rather than a coherent cell type, this is treated as the correct level rather than a term gap.
